$description: Canonical Catch design tokens. DTCG-shaped source for website CSS and Flutter primitive generators.

inventory.limit: Pinned research scope only; no assertion of every OS or UI-kit constant.

Typography.rationale: Native default type scales are imported; chosen Catch roles reference them with explicit deviations. Nondefault Dynamic Type sizes stay runtime-owned, never frozen as per-device font constants.

Typography tracking.rationale: Apple optical tracking tables depend on font,size and renderer; the system font selects optics, while Catch explicitly chooses zero tracking for functional styles. Mono caps and brand tracking are authored exceptions.

Accessibility.rationale: General font,target,contrast and enlargement guidance is imported and semantic floors consume it. Game-only control values do not describe Catch app controls. Runtime accessibility preferences remain platform-owned.

Layout & device metrics.rationale: Import Android window-class reference bounds without confusing them with Apple traits. Device pixel grids,densities and orientation tables are not safe-area or screen-padding constants; MediaQuery/LayoutBuilder own those values.

Components — Material.rationale: All pinned Material component constants are imported as native references, including button,chip,selection,text-field,tab,menu and list geometry. Catch adopts shared typography and interaction floors but retains its registered content-driven components and approved visual skin. Native nominal container heights are not maximum text heights.

Components — UIKit snapshot.rationale: Public UIKit configuration snapshots are not rendered geometry or normative minima. Adaptive native controls/frameworks own those configurations; custom Catch components use selected semantics and measured accessibility floors.

Components — Apple guidance.rationale: Import all published mobile component guidance; map attribution and native picker bounds remain with their platform/provider rather than become page dimensions or app business limits.

Shape.rationale: Import complete Material corner references; Catch retains its reviewed material shape roles. Full and directional corners are relationships, not device-specific radii.

Colors.rationale: Complete pinned Material palette and light/dark reference constants are imported. Catch deliberately retains its reviewed paper/ink/activity palette and validates semantic contrast rather than substituting the native Material color skin.

Colors — UIKit snapshot.rationale: UIColor values vary with OS,contrast and elevation traits. Do not freeze the snapshot into Catch colors; native adapters resolve system colors and custom components use the semantic Catch theme.

Elevation.rationale: Import Material elevation scale; Catch containment doctrine and semantic overlay owners choose depth rather than adopting native card shadows globally.

Interaction states.rationale: Import Material state opacity references. Catch hover,press,focus and selected treatments remain explicit semantic component states, not independent feature opacity recipes.

Motion.rationale: Import all Material and SwiftUI motion references except game/AR frame-rate recommendations. Preserve authored Catch timing; reduced motion and native physics remain runtime policy. Do not equate SwiftUI springs with cubic bezier curves.

Materials.rationale: Native blur/material recipes adapt to system traits and platform rendering. Catch surfaces retain the approved material system; no frozen UIKit visual-effect snapshot.

Assets & system surfaces.rationale: App icons,widgets,notifications,launch assets and system-surface geometry belong to their native asset/toolchain contracts, not Flutter page-layout tokens. No device safe-area inferred from these assets.

authoredExceptions.brandTypography: Archivo display,route,poster and welcome roles; approved78percent width
authoredExceptions.dataTypography: IBM Plex Mono explicit data/kicker/badge roles, not general reading copy
authoredExceptions.avatarTypography: Content-free avatar initials/count glyph size follows avatar diameter
authoredExceptions.rasterTypography: Icon-font raster art and simulated phone-frame clock are not app reading roles
authoredExceptions.spacing: Reviewed Catch20point gutter and16point body start; no universal OS margin exists
authoredExceptions.floatingNavigation: User explicitly retained current floating bottom navigation geometry and typography. The dedicated navigationLabel role preserves 13/13, weight 600 and zero tracking on both platforms independently of generic button styles.

palette.$description: Website v2 (House lights) brand palette. Owner decision 2026-10-25 (CAT-245): brand-wide, adopted by the website first and by the apps when their screens are redrawn. Every <accent>Deep passes WCAG AA text contrast on white and paper; every <accent>Ink passes it on its accent. packages/web-ui/src/components/palette.test.ts enforces both.

ink.$description: Warm ink: primary text on white, paper and every accent, and the fill of the ink ground.

inkSecondary.$description: Supporting text on white and paper.

black.$description: Absolute black for editorial scrims and on-photo fills (Flutter CatchTokens.editorialBlack).

nightSurface.$description: Raised surface on the ink ground.

nightInk.$description: Primary text on the ink ground and night surface.

nightSecondary.$description: Supporting text on the ink ground and night surface.

coralDeep.$description: Coral as text on white or paper.

coralInk.$description: Supporting text on a coral ground.

pinkDeep.$description: Pink as text on white or paper.

pinkInk.$description: Supporting text on a pink ground.

yellowDeep.$description: Yellow as text on white or paper.

yellowInk.$description: Supporting text on a yellow ground.

mintDeep.$description: Mint as text on white or paper.

mintInk.$description: Supporting text on a mint ground.

indigoDeep.$description: Indigo as text on white or paper.

indigoInk.$description: Supporting text on a indigo ground.

magentaDeep.$description: Magenta as text on white or paper.

magentaInk.$description: Supporting text on a magenta ground.

ground.$description: Grounds a surface or full-width band can take. Each names its fill, its primary ink and its supporting ink; both inks pass WCAG AA text contrast on the fill.

format.$description: Website v2 activity formats and the accent each one takes. accent fills a poster or tile, ink and inkSecondary are text on that fill, and deep is the format's colour as text on white or paper. singlesMixer belongs to no format, so its activity accent stays out of website use; the other activity kinds have no v2 format yet.

s28.$description: Website v2 section rhythm (112px), the spacious band padding.

space.$description: Catch shared spacing scale in logical units. Native component insets remain component-specific; do not substitute them for a universal screen gutter.

gap.$description: Semantic gaps named for the relationship they express: CatchGaps in Flutter, --catch-gap-* on the web. Each references the space scale.

inline.$description: Tight icon/label or metadata pair spacing.

headerTitleToSubtitle.$description: Screen-header title to its kicker or subtitle.

related.$description: Closely related rows inside one content cluster.

formField.$description: Controls in one form or settings group.

section.$description: Peer sections in a page body.

interactiveTile.$description: Active field and interactive tile corners: CatchRadius.interactiveTile.

radius.$description: Catch selected shape scale. Android native shape defaults remain separate references; native rounded-rectangle radii are not mandates to reskin existing Catch materials. Pill999 is a full-round sentinel, never a device radius.

stroke.$description: Stroke widths that are part of reusable component geometry: CatchStroke in Flutter, --catch-stroke-* on the web. Hairline is the default border width.

underline.$description: Typographic underline. Border emphasis uses the selected, danger or warning border roles instead.

layout.$description: Shared Catch geometry, not a claim that either OS prescribes one universal margin. Page20/16 and record40/12/8/4 values preserve reviewed shell/record composition; text containers are content-driven and hit targets are independent.

windowSize.$description: Material 3 window size class lower bounds: CatchWindowSize in Flutter. Compact is everything below medium. CSS custom properties cannot appear in @media, so web stylesheets get these values through the lint preset's media-query allowed list.

controlOverlayHover.$description: Ink tint over a row or control on hover: CatchOpacity.controlOverlayHover.

activityArtworkPattern.$description: Pattern marks over activity artwork: the EventBackdropImage.patternOpacity default in lib/contexts/events/parts/event_backdrop_image.dart.

activityArtworkGlyph.$description: Activity glyph over activity artwork: the EventBackdropImage.iconOpacity default in lib/contexts/events/parts/event_backdrop_image.dart.

groundCardOutline.$description: Website v2: ground-ink alpha of an outlined CatchGroundCard's stroke, as the boards draw white cards on a white page.

field.$description: Field row state values: CatchFieldTokens in Flutter, --catch-field-* on the web. Tint alphas apply to ink over the row surface.

restLineAlpha.$description: Website v2: ground-ink alpha of a resting field's box when a CatchGroundCard holds it, the WebOrgV2 board's boxed input. Flutter's fields have no ground card yet.

restTintOnDarkAlpha.$description: Website v2: ground-ink tint that fills a resting field on the dark ink ground card, where a white box would hide the field's light ink. Kept low so error ink on it still clears AA (4.7:1).

typography.$description: Catch function scale selected through Audience review. Ratified eleven roles remain explicit composition choices, not native defaults. iOS context13/18 follows Footnote, NOT Caption1(12/16). Native default reference metrics and provenance live in platformReference; Catch keeps compact16/24 body and zero functional tracking.

web.$description: Web function profile. Each role aliases the iOS semantic profile, because web body text renders in the platform system font as it does on iOS.

brand.$description: Platform-free brand text roles: Archivo voice and IBM Plex Mono data. Names match CatchTextStyles in Flutter and CatchText variants on the web. lineHeight is a unitless multiplier.

displayXs.$description: D19 display step. Smallest step; replaces headlineS and the small club and event display sizes. Archivo at 78% width and weight 760; tracking is in em.

displayS.$description: D19 display step. Replaces the large club and event display size. Archivo at 78% width and weight 760; tracking is in em.

displayM.$description: D19 display step. Replaces the extra-large club and event display size, eventTitle and the welcome reel. Archivo at 78% width and weight 760; tracking is in em.

displayL.$description: D19 display step. Replaces the old display role: onboarding, celebration, live countdowns. Archivo at 78% width and weight 760; tracking is in em.

displayXl.$description: D19 display step. Second-largest step, for hero moments. Archivo at 78% width and weight 760; tracking is in em.

displayXxl.$description: D19 display step. Largest step, for hero moments. Archivo at 78% width and weight 760; tracking is in em.

kicker.$description: Uppercase data kicker; tracking is 0.16em at 11px.

sectionCount.$description: Count beside a field section kicker.

monoCapsLabel.$description: Uppercase mono label; tracking is 0.13em at 11px.

interaction.$description: Minimum interactive extent; native iOS 44pt and Material Android 48dp. Logical units in Flutter.

platformReference.$description: Pinned mobile platform references, not global Catch defaults. Feature code must consume semantic roles. Native control skins, device geometry and runtime traits are explicitly not copied into fixed app dimensions.

org.catch.decision: Material standard curve selected on both platforms for Catch transitions; iOS native spring parameters are not equivalent cubic curves.

springCurve.$description: Explicit Catch overshoot curve for press and success feedback; not claimed to be a platform spring.

elevation.$description: Hairline-first lift shared by Flutter BoxShadow lists and website box-shadow values. Shadow ink is warm (26, 20, 16), not the text ink.

card.$description: Content cards that read as above the page while keeping the hairline border style.

raised.$description: Bottom sheets, floating actions and popovers.

layer.$description: Web stacking order (z-index). Flutter orders overlays through the widget tree and has no counterpart. Steps leave room between layers.

accessibility.$description: Cross-platform semantic accessibility acceptance floors. Text remains runtime-scaled and contrast is measured on the resolved foreground/background, not inferred from a palette name.
